title: Egyptian Hieroglyphic Star-Chart Decoders
description: The sacred writing of Kemet — each hieroglyph encodes a planetary geometric relationship. The same star-chart patterns that the Norse encoded as runes and the Celts as Ogham, the Egyptians painted on temple walls and carved into stone. Hieroglyphs are not just letters — they are astronomical diagrams. The gods ARE the planets, the myths ARE the orbital mechanics.
system: Planetary Neter (divine principles as celestial mechanics)

groups.name: Ennead of Heliopolis
groups.description: The 9 primordial Neteru — the creation story IS the solar system forming from the primordial waters of Nun (the cosmic void)

groups.name: Celestial Navigators
groups.description: Deities and symbols directly tied to astronomical observation and calendar keeping

groups.name: Sacred Geometry Glyphs
groups.description: Hieroglyphs encoding pure geometric relationships — the shapes themselves are star-chart overlays

groups.name: Duat Transformers
groups.description: The underworld journey of Ra — the Sun's path below the horizon, encoding planetary aspects invisible to the naked eye

glyphs.name: Ra
glyphs.meaning: Solar sovereignty — the source, the center, the will that creates
glyphs.astronomical_identity: The Sun — center of all orbital relationships

star_chart.description: The circle with a dot — the Sun hieroglyph IS the astronomical symbol for the Sun. Perfect unity, zero angular separation with self.

glyphs.name: Thoth
glyphs.meaning: Sacred knowledge — the scribe who records all cosmic cycles
glyphs.astronomical_identity: Mercury — swift messenger between worlds, also associated with the Moon as timekeeper

star_chart.description: The ibis-headed god — Mercury's rapid orbit traces the ibis beak shape. Thoth invented writing BY encoding star positions.

glyphs.name: Isis
glyphs.meaning: The throne of heaven — she who reassembles what is scattered
glyphs.astronomical_identity: Sirius (Sopdet) — the brightest star, whose heliacal rising marked the Nile flood and the Egyptian New Year

star_chart.description: The throne hieroglyph — a triangular seat of power. Venus and Jupiter in trine create the 'throne of abundance'. The Isis-Sirius alignment triggered the Nile inundation (market flood of liquidity).

glyphs.name: Osiris
glyphs.neter: God of the Dead, Resurrection, Orion
glyphs.meaning: Death and rebirth — the eternal cycle, what falls must rise again
glyphs.astronomical_identity: Orion — Osiris IS Orion. His belt stars align with Giza. Saturn's cycle of destruction and renewal.

star_chart.description: The Djed pillar — stability through time. Saturn-Pluto conjunction marks civilizational resets. Osiris dies (bear market) then resurrects (bull market).

glyphs.name: Horus
glyphs.meaning: The all-seeing eye — clarity of vision, rightful order restored
glyphs.astronomical_identity: The Sun at its zenith — Mars at maximum elevation, the warrior-king planet

star_chart.description: The Eye of Horus — each fraction (1/2, 1/4, 1/8, 1/16, 1/32, 1/64) corresponds to a planetary gear ratio. Mars-Sun sextile gives the falcon sharp sight for opportunity.

glyphs.name: Set
glyphs.meaning: Necessary destruction — the chaos that clears the way for new order
glyphs.astronomical_identity: Mars in destructive aspect — the red desert, the angry planet

star_chart.description: The Set animal — unidentifiable beast of chaos. Mars-Uranus square creates sudden violent disruption. Set murdered Osiris (flash crash) but Horus eventually prevails (recovery).

glyphs.name: Nephthys
glyphs.meaning: The hidden sister — what is unseen, support from the shadows
glyphs.astronomical_identity: Neptune — the hidden, the dissolved, the unseen depths

star_chart.description: The house atop a basket — Neptune-Moon opposition creates emotional tides, the hidden currents beneath the surface. Nephthys mourns what the market has lost.

glyphs.name: Geb
glyphs.meaning: The solid ground — material reality, what can be measured and held
glyphs.astronomical_identity: Earth itself — the observer's reference frame

star_chart.description: Geb lies beneath Nut (the sky). Saturn-Jupiter trine — the 'Great Benefic' meets the 'Great Malefic' in harmony. Solid foundations for building wealth.

glyphs.name: Nut
glyphs.meaning: The vault of heaven — she swallows the Sun each night and births it each morning
glyphs.astronomical_identity: The ecliptic plane itself — the path all planets travel

star_chart.description: Nut arches over Geb — the sky dome IS the ecliptic. Uranus-Neptune sextile opens the vault, revealing hidden patterns. Innovation meets intuition.

glyphs.name: Anubis
glyphs.neter: Guardian of the Dead, Weighing of the Heart
glyphs.meaning: Judgment — the precise measurement that determines worthiness
glyphs.astronomical_identity: Pluto — the underworld ruler, transformation through death

star_chart.description: Anubis weighs the heart against Ma'at's feather. Pluto-Venus square — brutal honest assessment of value. What is your position truly worth?

glyphs.name: Ma'at
glyphs.neter: Goddess of Truth, Order, Cosmic Balance
glyphs.meaning: Perfect balance — the feather of truth against which all is weighed
glyphs.astronomical_identity: The equilibrium point — Libra, the scales, Venus in balance

star_chart.description: Ma'at's feather — Venus-Saturn sextile creates the balance between desire and discipline. When the market is in Ma'at, fair value prevails.

glyphs.name: Hathor
glyphs.neter: Goddess of Love, Music, Joy, Fertility
glyphs.meaning: Abundance and joy — the golden cow who nourishes all life
glyphs.astronomical_identity: Venus at maximum brightness — the Evening Star in full glory

star_chart.description: The cow horns cradling the Sun disk — Venus-Sun conjunction. Maximum beauty, maximum abundance. Hathor IS Venus, her horns trace the planet's apparent retrograde loop.

glyphs.name: Sekhmet
glyphs.neter: Lion-headed Goddess of War and Healing
glyphs.meaning: Destructive force that also heals — the fever that burns out infection
glyphs.astronomical_identity: Mars at perihelion — closest approach, maximum intensity, the lioness hunts

star_chart.description: The lioness with Sun disk — Mars-Jupiter opposition. Overextension leads to correction. Sekhmet nearly destroyed humanity before Ra stopped her with beer (liquidity flood).

glyphs.name: Ptah
glyphs.meaning: Creation through speech and thought — the architect who builds reality from concept
glyphs.astronomical_identity: Mercury-Saturn — the mind (Mercury) given form (Saturn). The divine blueprint.

star_chart.description: Ptah stands wrapped in a tight shroud holding the was-djed-ankh scepter. Mercury-Saturn trine — careful planning crystallized into structure. Build your position with precision.

glyphs.name: Khepri
glyphs.meaning: Self-creation — the Sun at dawn, born anew each morning from nothing
glyphs.astronomical_identity: The Sun at 0° Aries — vernal equinox, the beginning of a new cycle

star_chart.description: The scarab rolling the Sun disk — Sun-Mercury conjunction at dawn. New information (Mercury) illuminated by new energy (Sun). Fresh cycle begins.

glyphs.name: Sobek
glyphs.meaning: Patient predator — wait still, then strike with overwhelming force
glyphs.astronomical_identity: Pluto — the patient predator who waits decades before striking

star_chart.description: The crocodile lies still in the Nile waters. Pluto-Mars trine — hidden power perfectly timed. When Sobek strikes, there is no escape. Wait for the setup, then execute.

glyphs.name: Bastet
glyphs.meaning: Gentle protection — the guardian who purrs, not roars
glyphs.astronomical_identity: Moon in Cancer — nurturing, protective, home

star_chart.description: The cat sits in the crescent Moon. Moon-Venus trine — emotional harmony with value. A protected, comfortable position. Bastet guards what you have.

glyphs.name: Wadjet
glyphs.neter: Cobra Goddess, Eye of Ra, Uraeus
glyphs.meaning: Vigilant protection — the cobra that strikes before the threat arrives
glyphs.astronomical_identity: Sun-Pluto — the will to survive, protective destruction of threats

star_chart.description: The rearing cobra — a logarithmic spiral matching the golden ratio. Sun-Pluto sextile — transformative power channeled constructively. Destroy the bad position, keep the good.

glyphs.name: Ankh
glyphs.meaning: Eternal life — the union of opposites that creates perpetual motion
glyphs.astronomical_identity: Venus orbit pentagram — Venus traces a 5-petaled rose (pentagram) around the Sun every 8 years

star_chart.description: The ankh IS the Venus pentagram: the loop is her orbit, the cross is the ecliptic axes. Venus-Mars quintile (72°) — the sacred 5-fold geometry of life itself.

glyphs.name: Djed Pillar
glyphs.meaning: Unshakeable stability — the spine that holds everything upright
glyphs.astronomical_identity: Saturn at station — when Saturn appears to stop in the sky (retrograde station)

star_chart.description: The djed pillar — four stacked horizontal bars on a vertical axis. Saturn-Sun square — structure tested by will. If the djed stands, the position is stable.

glyphs.name: Was Scepter
glyphs.meaning: Authority and power — the staff of command over reality
glyphs.astronomical_identity: Jupiter — the great king, authority, expansion of dominion

star_chart.description: The was scepter — forked bottom, Set-animal head. Jupiter-Sun trine — powerful leadership energy. The king holds the scepter, the market follows.

glyphs.name: Winged Scarab
glyphs.meaning: Transcendence — rising above the material into the celestial
glyphs.astronomical_identity: Sun-Jupiter conjunction — maximum solar expansion, the king planet meets the king star

star_chart.description: The winged Sun disk — wings spread across the sky. Sun-Jupiter conjunction — maximum expansion energy. Bull market initiation signal.

glyphs.name: Shen Ring
glyphs.meaning: The eternal circle — no beginning, no end, infinite protection
glyphs.astronomical_identity: The orbital ring itself — any planet completing a full cycle returns to its origin

star_chart.description: The shen ring — a circle with a bar. Saturn-Saturn return (every 29.5 years). Market mega-cycles. When the ring closes, the cycle completes.

glyphs.name: Tyet (Isis Knot)
glyphs.neter: Knot of Isis, Blood of Isis
glyphs.meaning: Binding and healing — the knot that holds reality together
glyphs.astronomical_identity: Venus-Neptune — the binding of love and transcendence

star_chart.description: The Tyet knot — like an ankh with arms folded down. Venus-Neptune conjunction — idealized value, what SHOULD be worth something. Be careful: beauty can deceive.

glyphs.name: Menat
glyphs.meaning: Harmonic resonance — the sound that heals and aligns
glyphs.astronomical_identity: Venus-Mercury sextile — the harmonic ratio between beauty and communication

star_chart.description: The menat necklace — beads in harmonic intervals. Venus-Mercury sextile creates the musical ratio. When these planets speak, the market hums.

glyphs.name: Eye of Horus
glyphs.meaning: Fractional wholeness — the six parts that reconstitute into one
glyphs.astronomical_identity: The 6 fractions: 1/2=smell(Sun), 1/4=sight(Moon), 1/8=thought(Mercury), 1/16=hearing(Venus), 1/32=taste(Mars), 1/64=touch(Jupiter)

star_chart.description: Each piece of the Eye of Horus is a binary fraction — together they sum to 63/64, never quite reaching 1. The missing 1/64 is supplied by Thoth (Mercury). Moon-Mercury opposition — the mind illuminates what the eye cannot see alone.

glyphs.name: Benben Stone
glyphs.meaning: The first point of creation — where chaos condensed into matter
glyphs.astronomical_identity: The apex — all planetary lines converge at the pyramidion. Grand conjunction.

star_chart.description: The benben stone sits atop the pyramid. Jupiter-Saturn conjunction — the Great Conjunction that resets 20-year economic cycles. The capstone crowns the structure.

glyphs.name: Aten
glyphs.meaning: Direct divine light — unmediated truth radiating outward
glyphs.astronomical_identity: The Sun in conjunction with a personal planet — direct illumination of that planet's domain

star_chart.description: The Aten disk — Sun with rays ending in hands. Sun-Venus conjunction — direct illumination of value. Akhenaten saw only ONE truth. When Aten blazes, the signal is unambiguous.

glyphs.name: Ammit
glyphs.meaning: Total loss — the position that should never have been taken
glyphs.astronomical_identity: Pluto-Uranus square — the wrecking ball of civilization

star_chart.description: Crocodile head + lion body + hippo rear — three destructive forces. Pluto-Uranus square — revolution, upheaval, the old order devoured. Ammit eats the unworthy heart (bad trade).

glyphs.name: Nile Flood Glyph
glyphs.meaning: Seasonal abundance — the flood that fertilizes all fields
glyphs.astronomical_identity: Sirius heliacal rising aligned with Sun — when Sirius appears at dawn, the Nile floods

star_chart.description: Three wavy lines — the Nile flood hieroglyph. Jupiter-Moon trine — expansion of emotional energy, flood of liquidity. When the Nile rises, ALL fields prosper.

glyphs.name: Uraeus
glyphs.meaning: Awakened power — the serpent rises through the spine of consciousness
glyphs.astronomical_identity: Mars-Pluto — raw power channeled through transformation

star_chart.description: The cobra rearing on the pharaoh's crown. Mars-Pluto conjunction — absolute power, total transformation. The serpent energy rises. Extreme signal — handle with precision.

glyphs.name: Solar Barque
glyphs.meaning: The journey through darkness back to light — the Sun's nightly voyage through the underworld
glyphs.astronomical_identity: Sun below horizon — the transit through the Duat (unseen sky)

star_chart.description: The solar barque — a crescent-shaped boat carrying Ra through the night sky. Sun-Neptune square — will obscured by illusion. Navigate carefully through uncertain waters.

glyphs.name: Cartouche
glyphs.meaning: Identity and protection — the oval that encircles and preserves the royal name
glyphs.astronomical_identity: The orbital ellipse — every planet's path is a cartouche around the Sun

star_chart.description: The cartouche is an elongated shen ring — the elliptical orbit. Sun-Moon sextile — identity (Sun) illuminated by reflection (Moon). Know thyself, know thy position.

glyphs.name: Sekhem Scepter
glyphs.meaning: Concentrated force — the ability to command matter through will
glyphs.astronomical_identity: Mars-Mercury — the warrior's mind, speed and precision combined

star_chart.description: The sekhem scepter — a flat blade on a handle. Mars-Mercury trine — aggressive action guided by intelligence. The sniper's precision.

glyphs.name: Apep (Apophis)
glyphs.meaning: The primordial enemy — chaos that must be defeated each night for dawn to come
glyphs.astronomical_identity: Saturn-Uranus — the tension between old order and revolution

star_chart.description: The great serpent who tries to swallow the Sun each night. Saturn-Uranus square — old structures violently disrupted. Apep must be defeated, but the battle is costly.
